firmware.name: UIFlow2.0 AtomU
firmware.source_discovery: M5Burner public API exposes no UIFlow2 AtomU entry (verified 2026-11-02); the reviewed pinned official GitHub release asset is the reference source and is verified fail-closed against the catalog sha256.

image.image_note: The official 4,186,112-byte sparse merged image is padded to 4 MiB with 0xFF; the console probe replaces only the LittleFS vfs volume.

runtime.qemu_source_base: native-lock tree with 0113-basic-v27-board.patch and 0114-unit-gpio-batch1.patch applied; AtomU board commit 1a2ea48
runtime.machine_desc: M5Stack AtomU K117 (ESP32-PICO-D4, SK6812, PDM microphone)

case.serial_log_note: hash of run 1; the ESP-IDF 'i2c.master' boot-warning timestamp varies with virtual-clock scheduling while all ATOMU_* markers and QOM values are identical in all three runs
case.button_injection: QMP key:a through the AtomU input handler -> ESP32 GPIO39 input register -> UIFlow2 BtnA; the guest reports press (1) and release (0) transitions and repaints the RGB value
case.i2c_scan_note: 0x48 is the QEMU classic ESP32 machine's built-in tmp105 test device on the board I2C bus; it is not an AtomU component and no Unit was attached. The scan proves the guest I2C controller/G26-G32 routing, not a Unit protocol.

verified: official UIFlow2 v2.5.4 AtomU 4 MiB image boot through ROM and second-stage bootloader
M5.begin() and M5.getBoard()=130 in one m5atomu guest
single SK6812 on GPIO27 driven through the ESP32 classic RMT path; host QOM decodes the final wire frame as RGB 0x204060 after 5 completed frames
QMP key:a drives GPIO39 through the board input handler; the guest reports press/release and repaints the LED
guest I2C controller on the Grove G26/G32 pins performs a bus scan (only the QEMU machine's tmp105 0x48 is present)
three independent matrix runs PASS with identical serial markers, probe image sha256 and QOM values
blocked: SPM1423 PDM microphone on G5/G19 is wired in the machine model (SoC I2S0 PDM RX) but this probe does not exercise it; no PCM evidence and therefore no microphone claim
IR transmitter G12 is not wired in the board model and not probed
Grove Unit protocols are not tested; the scan covers only the controller path
no display and no PSRAM on this board; display/PSRAM paths are not applicable
firmware source is a GitHub release asset, not an M5Burner firmware ID; the catalog entry is a reviewed SHA-pinned exception to the CDN rule
not_run: physical electrical, acoustic, optical or mechanical behavior
SPM1423 PDM capture, microphone sensitivity/SNR and analog audio path
Grove Unit data planes and host-port electrical compatibility
stock UIFlow2 startup menu/network and third-party firmware
browser/WASM admission and any other classic ESP32 host (Atom Lite/Atom Echo conclusions are not inherited)
